# dpc-radar

> Async Python client for the Italian Civil Protection (DPC) open radar data: SRI, Merging (CUM), history and criticality bulletins

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/agent-engineering-studio/dpc-radar): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://agentengineering.it/dpc-radar/): Official website and documentation.
